title: Exceedingly Optimized
description: This project adds only optimization mods and the two versions of Complimentary shaders for a buttery smooth experience. Now available for 26.1.2!
body: Welcome to the most optimized modpack for Minecraft 26.1.2. It boasts an incredibly high fps with the most downloaded optimization mods, like Sodium and Lithium. You can also use two very popular shaders, which can be adapted to your PC's liking.
